title: Mixed Event — Let SEKAI Hear Your Song! — Episode7 For The Other Me

meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGERS of each SEKAI see how everyone is progressing toward their goals. They are excitedly preparing ways to demonstrate their support for everyone, when something extraordinary happens.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh?
I'm back in my own SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But I wanted to talk to her more...
Does this mean I'm never gonna see her again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You won't believe it!
That voice I heard before was Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, the one that said, “You can do it!”
It was me, but not me, and she was trying to cheer for me and for all of us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
H-Hang on...
Take a deep breath for me first. Then, say what you just said a little more slowly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Interesting...
And you met a different Miku in this strange SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yup!
Me-but-not-me said our shows give her lots of encouragement every time she watches!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She also said how Tsukasa and the others are gonna be just fine as long as we keep trying our best for them!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she wished us luck in the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we'll also need to do our best to not disappoint her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Our show's gonna be so amazing☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I still can't believe what happened.
To think that I'd meet another me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I thought we were the only ones watching over Vivid BAD SQUAD from a SEKAI until now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But to find out that there are others watching over us...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't help but feel encouraged!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? KAITO, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len and the others have been looking all over for you. They're mad about you not helping them get ready for our event!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, Luka, you met a different Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and guess what she said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She thanked us for always supporting the girls and said she hopes that we'll keep doing our best since all they can do is watch over them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means this other you also wants what's best for Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She does. She may even be watching over us and this SEKAI right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we have to make our show the best we've ever done! To give hope not just to Minori and the others, but to this other Luka as well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree!
Which means we'll have to practice quite a lot to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
He is...
Something good must've happened.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Like what?!
Oh, maybe he won some free ice cream or something!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Only you and KAITO would be jumping for joy over that, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I think our show's going to be quite a good one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can tell from the way you're singing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You want them to feel your kindness. You want to be there for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, for Mafuyu's sake. For all their sakes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also, I'm singing on behalf of the other me watching over me.
